name: adaptive-task-routing
description: Recommend when to start a new conversation and which model and reasoning effort fit the next phase, helping reduce unnecessary usage and rework.

interface.shortDescription: Help reduce wasted AI usage and rework.
interface.longDescription: Adaptive Task Routing helps reduce interference from previous tasks, unnecessary AI usage, and the risk of omissions and rework. Before the next substantial phase, it recommends whether to start a new conversation, with a concise handoff when needed, so old assumptions and constraints are less likely to affect new work. It then provides minimum-sufficient and recommended model and reasoning settings and explains the value of upgrading. The AI presents the requested analysis or plan first. Default ask mode waits for your decision; auto applies supported, verifiable changes and continues authorized work, retaining current settings when switching is unavailable. Actual savings and reliability depend on the task and settings adopted.
defaultPrompt: Use adaptive task routing before the next substantial phase.
